analysis_definition.primary_question: Does success degrade differently as arm versus gripper source age increases?
analysis_definition.task_macro_note: Task macro summaries weight each task equally; their bootstrap resamples task-level paired contrasts.
analysis_definition.pooled_note: Pooled summaries are descriptive across paired episodes and do not replace task-macro results.
analysis_definition.mcnemar_note: Exact two-sided McNemar values are paired diagnostics; Holm correction is across the 15 core age-by-contrast tests within the displayed scope.
analysis_definition.ci_note: Percentile bootstrap intervals use 10,000 deterministic resamples and are descriptive unless a later confirmatory plan designates a scope.
